safetyGuarantees.noRandomSelection: When providers disagree, system does not pick a random provider.
safetyGuarantees.noStaleWinner: Stale provider data cannot override active primary.
safetyGuarantees.noElapsedHeuristic: Disagreement cannot be auto-resolved by elapsed time.
safetyGuarantees.mandatoryBlock: Any divergence on material scores (> 1 run) or status strictly sets confidence to CONFIDENCE_STATES.CONFLICT and blocks financial settlement.
